query.text: 请帮我留意孩子们的集体活动和站队情况，有不规范或需要帮助的情况及时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please help me keep an eye on the children's group activities and line-up, and tell me in time if there is any improper behavior or if they need help.

annotation.text_zh: 最左边的小朋友趴在地上，没有跟着站队。
annotation.text_en: The child on the far left is lying on the ground and isn't lining up.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
